description: "Fixed critical issues where Primitives benchmark was creating duplicate TPC-H data in primitives_sf* directories and corrupting shared TPC-H manifests. Implemented data sharing infrastructure allowing Primitives to automatically use TPC-H data from tpch_sf* directories. Added comprehensive documentation and 12 new tests covering data sharing, manifest isolation, and CLI orchestrator behavior."
